intro: A sound for the stairs walk (2026-10-14): the slime is carried up or down a flight one step at a time, 200 ms per step, four steps per level. You did not like the first sound, so here are six kinds. Play the single takes, and press Climb to hear an option at the pace of the stairs walk. The game plays option A meanwhile. Pick one, or choose Neither and say how it should sound.

groups.name: Stairs
groups.note: One sound per step while the slime climbs or descends a flight of stone stairs; the normal footsteps are quiet meanwhile.

cues.name: Stairs step
cues.where: Each step of the stairs walk (8 steps for a two-level flight)

options.label: Stone tap
options.note: A clean tap of a small step on a stone stair, with a short low thud

options.label: Slime squelch
options.note: The slime hopping onto each step: a soft wet squelch with a light tap on stone

options.label: Wooden knock
options.note: A warm, hollow knock, like a step on a wooden stair

options.label: Woodblock tick
options.note: A tiny rounded woodblock tick, a cartoon game step

options.label: Sandy scuff
options.note: A step with a short gritty scrape of sand on old stone

options.label: Jelly plop
options.note: A muted, rubbery plop of a jelly body landing on hard stone
